subject.why: The horseshoe is instantly recognisable, thick and chunky with nail holes, and has the requested sky-blue ribbon bow.

category.why: The horseshoe floats cleanly in mid-air with a three-quarter tilt against a radial background with no ground or props.

clean.why: No text, UI elements, watermarks, frames, or characters are present.

framing.why: The object is centrally framed with comfortable, even margins on all sides and a readable silhouette.

colour.why: Vibrant warm red background with clear contrast against the polished silver steel and sky-blue ribbon.

detail.why: No busy micro-textures or excessive surface noise; details are bold, stylized, and clean.

style.why: Smooth, chunky 3D rendering with soft satin highlights and no outlines, matching the reference cards perfectly.

bg_colour.why: background is red (99% of the background); planned red
